title: refactor(GroundTheory/AutomorphicForms/GL2): add natDegree bound to local zeta pipeline and remove duplicates in GJUnramified
body:
Thread the denominator degree bound `D.natDegree ≤ n` directly through the Godement–Jacquet local zeta rationality pipeline so `GJUnramified` no longer duplicates the entire pipeline to obtain that bound.

Strengthens (adds `D.natDegree ≤ n` to the existential conclusion):
- `GroundTheory.Automorphic.GodementJacquet.exists_leviZeta` (`GJLeviZeta.lean`)
- `GroundTheory.Automorphic.GodementJacquet.exists_inducedZeta` (`GJInducedZeta.lean`)
- `GroundTheory.Automorphic.GodementJacquet.exists_zeta_core` (`GJZetaCore.lean`)
- `GroundTheory.Automorphic.GodementJacquet.exists_zeta_rat` (`GJLocalZeta.lean`)
- `GroundTheory.Automorphic.GodementJacquet.exists_zetaSet_eq` (`GJLocalZeta.lean`)
- `GroundTheory.Automorphic.GodementJacquet.exists_denominator_zetaIdeal` (`GJLocalZeta.lean`)

Removes duplicate declarations from `GJUnramified.lean`:
- `GroundTheory.Automorphic.GodementJacquet.exists_leviZeta_natDegree`
- `GroundTheory.Automorphic.GodementJacquet.exists_inducedZeta_natDegree`
- `GroundTheory.Automorphic.GodementJacquet.exists_zeta_core_natDegree`
- `GroundTheory.Automorphic.GodementJacquet.exists_zeta_rat_natDegree`
- `GroundTheory.Automorphic.GodementJacquet.exists_zetaSet_eq_natDegree`
- `GroundTheory.Automorphic.GodementJacquet.exists_denominator_zetaIdeal_natDegree`

Updates `exists_integrable_zetaIntegral`, `existsUnique_zetaIdeal_eq`, and `natDegree_LPolynomial_le` to use the strengthened pipeline, and drops four now-unused private imports from `GJUnramified.lean`.
